raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Motivation

#47149 made `mega_moe_pre_dispatch` launch 320-thread CTAs with two 16B chunks per thread on SMs that hold 1024 resident threads (CC 10.7 / sm_107), since two 640-thread CTAs do not fit. That PR measured decode-sized batches. At prefill-sized batches (thousands of rows) the kernel is still launch-bound: one CTA per token, three resident per SM.

## Modifications

- `mega_moe_pre_dispatch.cuh`: add a four-chunks-per-thread instantiation (160-thread CTAs for hidden 5120). It is used when the two-chunk launch already applies (1024-thread SMs), `num_chunks` is a multiple of 128, `top_k <= num_chunks / 4`, and `num_tokens >= 6 x SM count`.
- Below that row count, and on 2048-thread SMs, the launch is unchanged. The cutoff comes from the sweep below: four chunks lose 3-16% at 424-1024 rows and win from about 1.3K rows up.

Outputs are bitwise identical (FP8 bytes, scales, shared-SF layout, top-k copies and padding).

## Accuracy Tests

On sm_107 (CC 10.7), at this PR's head:

- `test/registered/kernels/ops/moe/test_mega_moe_pre_dispatch.py`: 6 passed.
- This PR against its parent at 198, 342, 1024, 1272, 4096 and 16384 rows: all outputs bitwise identical.

## Benchmarking and Profiling

sm_107 (CC 10.7), one GPU, hidden 5120, top_k 6, 4 calls per CUDA graph, ABBA-interleaved replays, median time per call relative to the parent (hot = one buffer set, cold = rotated):

| rows | this PR vs parent, hot | cold |
|---|---|---|
| 198 | -2.9% | +5.5% |
| 342 | -4.3% | +4.4% |
| 1024 | +2.3% | 0.0% |
| 1272 | -3.9% | -14.3% |
| 4096 | -11.4% | -18.6% |
| 16384 | -23.9% | -24.1% |

Rows at or below 1024 take the same kernel as the parent, so their differences are run-to-run spread. DeepSeek-V4.1 prefill at 16K tokens per rank calls this kernel once per MoE layer at 16384 rows. No end-to-end number is claimed.

## Checklist

- [x] Format your code according to the pre-commit hooks.
- [ ] Add unit tests (the four-chunk path only runs on 1024-thread SMs; covered by the bitwise comparison above).
- [ ] Update documentation as needed.
- [x] Provide accuracy and speed benchmark results (kernel level).
